newsitem.title: USA: Amertranz says to buy freight forwarder.
newsitem.headline: Amertranz says to buy freight forwarder.

text.p: Amertranz Worldwide Holding Corp said on Friday it had entered into a definitive agreement to buy a U.S.-based freight forwarder with more than $21 million in annual revenues.
The acquisition, which will be merged into one of its subsidiaries, is expected to be complete by the end of May and will be primarily for Amertranz common stock, the company said in a statement.
Amertranz chief executive Stuart Hettleman said the acquisition underscored the company's long term strategy "to expand through acquisitions."

Upon completion of the transaction, Amertranz will have annual sales volume of about $100 million, the company said, adding that it will continue to pursue other acquisitions in the future and that like the present acquisition, they will be accretive to earnings.
Amertranz provides freight forwarding services through its wholly owned subsidiaries Amertranz Worldwide Inc and Caribbean Air Services.
